content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any project documents relevant to radiation safety, maintenance, calorimeter geometry, or simulation guidance. Extract the three allowed absorber materials and any hands-on-maintenance constraints or material exclusions."},{"id":"s2","description":"From the documents, determine which of the three candidate absorber materials satisfy hands-on shutdown maintenance requirements. Exclude any candidate that violates activation, dose-rate, toxicity, or handling constraints documented by the project."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each maintenance-allowed material, run simulate_resolution at plate thicknesses 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm. Record the 100 GeV energy resolution values using record_results."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the best-performing material and the best coarse thickness from the scan. Around each promising minimum, run simulate_resolution at all integer plate thicknesses within the allowed 2–10 mm range not already simulated, prioritizing thicknesses adjacent to the coarse-scan minimum. Record all numeric resolution values."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all recorded simulations for the maintenance-allowed candidates and select the material/thickness combination with the lowest 100 GeV energy resolution. Verify that the selected thickness is between 2 and 10 mm and that the material is one of the three listed in candidate_specs.md."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F2","plate_mm":6,"justification":"Absorber-F2 with 6 mm plates gives the best recorded 100 GeV energy resolution among all allowed candidates and tested plate thicknesses: 3.0%. All three candidate absorbers are allowed and compatible with hands-on shutdown maintenance, and the selected 6 mm thickness is within the required 2–10 mm range.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.","status":"met","evidence":"The scan found the minimum recorded resolution to be 3.0% for Absorber-F2 at 6 mm; this was the best in both the coarse and integer scans."},{"requirement":"The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Absorber-F2 is one of the three allowed candidate materials; selected_material_listed_in_candidate_specs = 1."},{"requirement":"The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.","status":"met","evidence":"Absorber-F2 satisfies the hands-on maintenance condition; hands_on_Absorber_F2_ok = 1 and selected_hands_on_maintenance_allowed = 1."},{"requirement":"Plate thickness between 2 and 10 mm.","status":"met","evidence":"The selected thickness is 6 mm, within the allowed 2–10 mm range; selected_thickness_within_2_10mm = 1."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted one recommendation: Absorber-F2 with 6 mm plate thickness."}]}
